Let it be hewn into your mind!|Hero's Spirit|TPHD}}</ref> and the {{Term/Store|Shield Bash|Shield Bashes|SS, SSHD}},{{Exp Game|SS}}<ref name="Technique">{{Cite|This technique is called a {{Color SSHD|Red|shield bash}}, and it will make the enemy recoil, giving you an opening in which to attack.|Eagus|SSHD}}</ref> is a recurring ability in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Overview==
==={{TP|-}}===
The Shield Attack is the second [[Hidden Skill]] that [[Link]] can learn. This Hidden Skill lets Link bash the enemy with his [[Shield]] to open their defenses. The Shield Attack can be learned by first finding the [[Howling Stone]] located on the trail leading to [[Death Mountain]].<ref>{{Cite|Search for the statues that howl with the {{Color TPHD|Red|sound of the wind}}. Seek the sound that calls the spirit of the beast to awaken me again.|Hero's Spirit|TPHD}}</ref> Howling at the Howling Stone awakens the [[White Wolf]], who joins in howling with [[Wolf Link]]. After howling with the White Wolf, the White Wolf instructs Link to find him while in human form and marks where he will wait on Link's [[Map]].<ref>{{Cite|Let teachings of old pass to you... Take sword in hand and find me...|White Wolf|TPHD}}</ref> Once Link returns to human form, he can find the White Wolf waiting at the [[Ordon Spring]]. Approaching the White Wolf can return Link to the clouded area where he can find the Hero's Spirit and learn the Shield Attack.

To perform the Shield Attack on the GameCube version, Link must get close enough to the enemy while targeting it and then press the R-Button, which will cause the enemy to lower its defense and thus allow Link to attack the foe with another skill, such as the [[Helm Splitter]].<ref>{{Cite|What ails you? You cannot shield-attack with [R] unless you lock on with [L] first! Get closer to your foe and shield-attack with [R]!|Hero's Spirit|TP}}</ref><ref name="Skill Info"/> In the Wii version of {{TP|-}}, this Hidden Skill can be executed by thrusting the [[Nunchuk]] forward.<ref name="Shield">{{Cite|While [Z]-targeting your enemy, thrust the Nunchuk forward to shove with your shield. You can also reflect your foe's projectiles!|N/A|TP}}</ref>

Other than bringing the enemy's defenses down, the Shield Attack can also be used to deflect certain enemy projectiles.<ref name="Shield"/><ref>{{Cite|The {{Color TPHD|Red|shield attack}} I just taught you can also be used to {{Color TPHD|Red|repel}} an enemy's projectile attacks.|Hero's Spirit|TPHD}}</ref>

==={{SS|-}}===
[[Link]] can learn the Shield Bash ability after first acquiring a [[Shield]].<ref>{{Cite|... Get a {{Color SS|Red|shield}} and come back here! Then I'll be able to teach you the {{Color SS|Red|secrets of defense}}!...|Eagus|SS}}</ref> The Knight Commander, [[Eagus]] teaches Link this ability at the [[Sparring Hall]].<ref>{{Cite|If you're not sure how to use a shield, {{Color SS|Blue|Knight Commander Eagus}} at the Sparring Hall will happily teach you.|Owlan|SS}}</ref> To perform the Shield Bash, Link must ready his Shield right before an enemy attacks him. The force from his Shield arm will repel the enemy's attack,<ref>{{Cite|If you ready your shield before an enemy attacks you, the force from your shield arm will {{Color SS|Green|repel}} the enemy's attack.|Eagus|SS}}</ref> which does not deplete [[Durability]]. The Shield Bash gives Link an opening to strike his opponent.<ref name="Technique"/> The technique is useful against enemies who throw weapons or refuse to give an opening.<ref>{{Cite|This technique is very useful against enemies who throw weapons at you or just refuse to give you an opening for attack.|Eagus|SS}}</ref> Using the Shield Bash to parry an attack requires perfect timing in battle.<ref>{{Cite|In a real battle, pulling off a defensive shield maneuver requires perfect timing. Believe me, you really don't want to miss.|Eagus|SS}}</ref> Link can practice this ability on the [[Defense-Practice Log]] in the Sparring Hall.<ref>{{Cite|Why don't you put what you learned to use with that {{Color SS|Red|defense-practice log}}?|Eagus|SS}}</ref>

==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Stub|BotW}}
[[Link]] can Parry by readying his [[Shield]] and pressing the A button in {{BotW}}. By Parrying at the right time, Link can execute a [[Perfect Guard]], which will unbalance Enemies and redirect projectiles. Doing so will not damage the Shield.
